description: This Java class implements an HttpSessionListener that tracks session creation and destruction events, manages session-related data such as visits and user login sessions, logs session statistics, and maintains counters for active and passive sessions within the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: ControlEventListener
classes.description: A session listener class that tracks session lifecycle events, manages session data, logs statistics, and maintains session counters within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: sessionCreated
methods.description: Handles actions to perform when a new HTTP session is created, including incrementing session counters and setting logging attributes.

methods.name: sessionDestroyed
methods.description: Handles cleanup and persistence tasks when an HTTP session is destroyed, including updating visit and user login session data, and logging session statistics.

methods.name: logStats
methods.description: Logs detailed statistics and attributes of a session and its associated visit data.

methods.name: getTotalActiveSessions
methods.description: Returns the total number of active sessions.

methods.name: getTotalPassiveSessions
methods.description: Returns the total number of passive (passivated) sessions.

methods.name: getTotalSessions
methods.description: Returns the total number of sessions (active + passive).

methods.name: countCreateSession
methods.description: Increments the count of active sessions.

methods.name: countDestroySession
methods.description: Decrements the count of active sessions.

methods.name: countPassivateSession
methods.description: Moves a session from active to passive count.

methods.name: countActivateSession
methods.description: Reactivates a passive session, updating counters accordingly.

methods.name: getUserLoginSession
methods.description: Serializes the user login session data into XML format for storage.
